verdicts.line: You sleep. A generation passes. Where you lie down, your light keeps working.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: where you sleep, your light keeps working
verdicts.reason: Direct quote from the tutorial narration spec, exactly the register and mechanical consequence demanded.

verdicts.line: Sleep ends the cycle. The body you leave behind radiates for every tick of the generation that follows.
verdicts.reason: "The body you leave behind" is mythological phrasing where instrumentation is required; the tutorial teaches verbs, not imagery.
verdicts.correction: Sleep ends the cycle. Where you rest, your flame radiates for every tick of the generation.

verdicts.line: When you sleep, a whole generation passes—and the sleeping body keeps glowing.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the sleeping body radiates the flame's emotion over a radius (~3 tiles, grows with Ascension) for every tick of the generation
verdicts.reason: "keeps glowing" loses the mechanical consequence that it radiates emotion with spatial effect; any god-game has glowing.
verdicts.correction: Sleep. A generation passes, and where you lie radiates your flame's emotion until you wake.

verdicts.line: Sleep. One generation turns while you rest, and where you lie becomes a beacon until you wake.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the sleeping body radiates the flame's emotion over a radius (~3 tiles, grows with Ascension) for every tick of the generation
verdicts.reason: "becomes a beacon" contradicts the chunk: beacons are a separate verb with a cap; sleep radiates but is not a beacon.
verdicts.correction: Sleep. One generation turns while you rest, and where you lie radiates your flame until you wake.

verdicts.line: You sleep, and the world moves on without you. But the ground where you lay remembers what you felt.
verdicts.reason: "the world moves on without you" and "the ground where you lay remembers what you felt" are mythological flourishes, not instrumentation.
verdicts.correction: You sleep, and a generation passes. Where you rest, your flame keeps radiating.

verdicts.line: Sleep advances a generation. Your body stays—a light that works through every tick you're gone.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the sleeping body radiates the flame's emotion over a radius (~3 tiles, grows with Ascension) for every tick of the generation
verdicts.reason: Names the verb, states the mechanical consequence (body stays, radiates through ticks), maintains instrumentation register.

verdicts.line: When stamina runs out, you sleep. A generation passes. Where you choose to rest, your flame never stops.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: when stamina is gone, the only remaining verb is Sleep
verdicts.reason: "your flame never stops" introduces permanence the chunks don't support; sleep radiation lasts the generation, not forever.
verdicts.correction: When stamina runs out, you sleep. A generation passes, and where you rest radiates until you wake.

verdicts.line: Sleep. The generation turns, and wherever you laid down keeps radiating until dawn.
verdicts.quoted_chunk: the sleeping body radiates the flame's emotion over a radius (~3 tiles, grows with Ascension) for every tick of the generation
verdicts.reason: Names the verb, states duration (generation turns) and consequence (keeps radiating until dawn), pure instrumentation.
